question: trip counts by pickup zone for zones overlapping this bbox: (-74.02, 40.68, -73.94, 40.76)
sql: SELECT z.location_id, COUNT(*) AS pickup_trips FROM nyc_taxi_trips t JOIN nyc_taxi_zones z ON t.PULocationID = z.location_id WHERE ST_Intersects(z.geom, ST_MakeEnvelope(-74.02, 40.68, -73.94, 40.76)) GROUP BY z.location_id ORDER BY z.location_id

question: geojson of zones containing the point (-73.9857, 40.7484), with jan 2024 pickup counts
sql: SELECT z.location_id, COUNT(*) AS pickup_trips, ST_AsGeoJSON(z.geom) AS zone_geojson FROM nyc_taxi_zones z JOIN nyc_taxi_trips t ON t.PULocationID = z.location_id WHERE ST_Contains(z.geom, ST_Point(-73.9857, 40.7484)) AND t.tpep_pickup_datetime >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND t.tpep_pickup_datetime < TIMESTAMP '2024-02-01' GROUP BY z.location_id, z.geom ORDER BY z.location_id

question: pickup counts for zones touching taxi zone 114
sql: SELECT z.location_id, COUNT(*) AS pickup_trips FROM nyc_taxi_zones z JOIN nyc_taxi_trips t ON t.PULocationID = z.location_id WHERE z.location_id <> 114 AND ST_Touches(z.geom, (SELECT geom FROM nyc_taxi_zones WHERE location_id = 114)) GROUP BY z.location_id ORDER BY z.location_id

question: trips where the pickup zone lies inside the dropoff zone
sql: SELECT pu.location_id AS pickup_zone, dz.location_id AS dropoff_zone, COUNT(*) AS trips FROM nyc_taxi_trips t JOIN nyc_taxi_zones pu ON t.PULocationID = pu.location_id JOIN nyc_taxi_zones dz ON t.DOLocationID = dz.location_id WHERE ST_Contains(dz.geom, pu.geom) GROUP BY pu.location_id, dz.location_id ORDER BY pu.location_id, dz.location_id

question: trips with pickup zone intersecting this line: LINESTRING(-73.98 40.75, -73.97 40.76, -73.95 40.77)
sql: SELECT z.location_id, COUNT(*) AS pickup_trips FROM nyc_taxi_trips t JOIN nyc_taxi_zones z ON t.PULocationID = z.location_id WHERE ST_Intersects(z.geom, ST_GeomFromText('LINESTRING(-73.98 40.75, -73.97 40.76, -73.95 40.77)')) GROUP BY z.location_id ORDER BY z.location_id

question: count trips that start and end in zones fully within this envelope: (-74.03, 40.69, -73.93, 40.79)
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS trips FROM nyc_taxi_trips t JOIN nyc_taxi_zones pu ON t.PULocationID = pu.location_id JOIN nyc_taxi_zones dz ON t.DOLocationID = dz.location_id WHERE ST_Within(pu.geom, ST_MakeEnvelope(-74.03, 40.69, -73.93, 40.79)) AND ST_Within(dz.geom, ST_MakeEnvelope(-74.03, 40.69, -73.93, 40.79))
